attributes.name: Orcish Earthbreaker +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 2d6+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6, or 2d6 if the bane has the Construct trait. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

Recharge this card to add 1d10 to your check against a barrier.
